title: Senior Systems Analyst - Commercial Risk
jd_text: Senior Systems Analyst Houston Texas l IT Department Talen Energy is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Systems Analyst to join our Information Technology team supporting Commercial Risk applications, including Openlink, PowerOptix, cQuant, and custom applications. The Senior Systems Analyst will play a key role in the implementation, support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of applications and integrations supporting Commercial Risk and related business processes. This position serves as an important liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, combining strong technical and analytical capabilities with a thorough understanding of business processes. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, effective communication and organizational abilities, a high degree of ownership, and a commitment to delivering reliable technology solutions and exceptional customer service in a fast-paced trading environment. How You’ll Power the Future At Talen Energy, your work directly supports safe, reliable power generation. Provide day-to-day production support for Commercial Risk applications, proactively managing incidents and ensuring timely issue resolution, effective escalation, and clear communication with business users. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Commercial Risk business processes, workflows, data, applications, and integrations to provide effective technology solutions and support. Analyze business processes and workflows to identify inefficiencies, operational risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation, application enhancements, and process improvements. Investigate and troubleshoot complex application, integration, data, and business-process issues, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating corrective actions as appropriate. Document production issues, system configurations, business requirements, functional designs, enhancements, processes, procedures, and support knowledge to appropriate standards. Participate in application releases, upgrades, patches, configuration changes, and production deployments, including planning, testing, implementation, and post-deployment validation. Develop, review, and execute test scenarios and test cases for system enhancements, integrations, upgrades, and defect remediation to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements. Partner with business users during user acceptance testing (UAT), assisting with test preparation, defect management, issue resolution, and validation of business outcomes. Support the execution, documentation, and evidence requirements associated with SOX controls, application controls, change management, and other applicable governance and audit requirements. Monitor application performance and operational processes, identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, data quality, supportability, and overall operational efficiency. Participate in project and enhancement initiatives, managing assigned deliverables and coordinating dependencies to support successful implementation. Prepare and present system recommendations, project updates, issue assessments, and other deliverables to audiences ranging from end users and subject-matter experts to senior leadership. Follow established IT policies, standards, change-management practices, security requirements, and development/support processes. Promote continuous improvement by identifying and implementing opportunities to improve application functionality, support processes, documentation, automation, and overall team effectiveness. (Openlink, PowerOptix, cQuant) Strong knowledge of Front to Back business processes including trade exchange integration, trade capture, mark-to-market, confirmations, settlements and accounting, compliance, and risk reporting Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases , with the ability to analyze data and perform application and integration troubleshooting. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex issues, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and recommend practical solutions. title: Inventory Control Specialist - Third Shift
jd_text: Work Schedule Second Shift (Afternoons) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. The Inventory Control Specialist is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records, ensuring material availability, supporting inventory transactions, and driving continuous improvement throughout inventory management processes. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for inventory activities while working closely with Manufacturing, Production Planning, Quality and Finance to ensure inventory accuracy and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate possesses SAP inventory management experience, a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, excellent problem-solving skills, a willingness to teach and willingness to learn. Key Responsibilities Inventory Management Maintain accurate inventory records across manufacturing warehouses, production locations, and storage areas. Monitor inventory levels and identify potential shortages, excess inventory, and obsolete materials. Conduct cycle counts on a regular basis and actively supports physical inventory activities. Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, variances, and transaction errors. Analyze inventory movements and recommend corrective and preventative actions to improve accuracy. Support inventory reconciliation activities between physical inventory and ERP system records. SAP Inventory Control Execute and monitor SAP inventory transactions, including: Goods Receipts (GR) Goods Issues (GI) Transfer Postings Stock Transfers Inventory Adjustments Cycle Count Processing Physical Inventory Documentation Ensure SAP master data accuracy related to: Material Masters Storage Locations Inventory Parameters Units of Measure Batch Number Controls Troubleshoot inventory-related SAP transaction issues and collaborate with IT or SAP support teams, as needed. Work in developing and maintaining SAP reports, queries, and inventory performance metrics. Inventory Analysis & Reporting Generate and distribute inventory status reports and KPI dashboards. Monitor key metrics including: Inventory Accuracy Cycle Count Compliance Stock Availability Excess & Obsolete Inventory Identify trends and implement actions to improve inventory performance. Support month-end and year-end inventory closing activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Production Planning to ensure material availability. Work with Procurement and Suppliers to resolve receipt and inventory discrepancies. Collaborate with Warehouse Operations to improve inventory control processes throughout Manufacturing. Support Finance during inventory audits and reconciliation activities. Participate in continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives. Compliance & Process Improvement Ensure adherence to company inventory policies and procedures. Support internal and external audits. Maintain documentation related to inventory control activities. Identify opportunities to improve inventory processes using SAP functionality and best practices. Required Qualifications 2+ years of experience in manufacturing, warehousing, or supply chain environment High School Diploma or equivalent Preferred Qualifications Working knowledgeable in completing production and inventory transactions Microsoft Outlook Experience in supporting cycle counts and physical inventories. Analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to complete inventory transactions in a timely and accurate manner. Demonstrated punctuality, and strong attendance Experience with SAP S/4HANA, or JD Edwards Experience in a manufacturing environment. Knowledge of SAP modules including: MM (Materials Management) EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) PP (Production Planning) APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) a plus. Experience with barcode scanning and warehouse automation systems. Lean Manufacturing Understanding of inventory accounting principles and transaction controls. Ideal Candidate Key Competencies SAP Inventory Management Expertise Inventory Accuracy & Reconciliation Data Analysis & Reporting Root Cause Analysis Process Improvement Attention to Detail Cross-Functional Collaboration Problem Solving Customer Focus Continuous Improvement Mindset

jd_text: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here! Summary The SFMC Product Owner is responsible for leading the strategy, governance, and ongoing optimization of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Hightouch Customer Data Platform. This role includes the platform roadmap, stakeholder intake, prioritization, campaign operations planning, release coordination, platform configuration oversight, business unit management, documentation, and escalated issue resolution. The role serves as the primary bridge between Marketing, IT, data, compliance, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure Salesforce Marketing Cloud is stable, secure, scalable, and aligned to business goals. Duties & Responsibilities Own and maintain the Salesforce Marketing Cloud roadmap, ensuring platform priorities align with marketing strategy, customer engagement goals, business line needs, and enterprise technology direction. Manage stakeholder intake, requirements gathering, prioritization, and backlog planning for campaigns, journeys, automations, platform enhancements, and operational improvements. Lead campaign operations planning, including intake workflows, production timelines, QA checkpoints, approvals, deployment readiness, release coordination, and post-launch review. Ensure alignment across multiple product backlogs and should always be considering how to maximize value, assessing how the product or the delivery process can be improved. Visibility into platform health, system performance, send readiness, deliverability signals, data movement, and operational risks; manage escalated issues and coordinate resolution with internal teams, Salesforce, and vendor partners. Partner with IT, CRM, data, analytics, privacy, compliance, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable platform capabilities, data requirements, and marketing automation solutions. Establish and maintain governance standards, documentation, naming conventions, folder structures, operating procedures, QA checklists, and training materials for Salesforce Marketing Cloud users and stakeholders. Support the design, execution, and optimization of customer journeys, email campaigns, automations, segmentation strategies, and personalization use cases across the customer lifecycle. Coordinate platform releases, Salesforce updates, vendor escalations, enhancement requests, and change management activities to minimize risk and maximize business value. Analyze platform usage, campaign operations, performance trends, and stakeholder needs to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, personalization, scalability, and value realization. Ensure marketing automation activity follows applicable compliance, consent, privacy, data governance, and deliverability standards. Serve as the internal subject matter expert for Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities, limitations, operating model, governance, and best practices. Qualifications Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum Experience 5+ years of experience in marketing automation, marketing operations, CRM, digital marketing, or related marketing technology roles. Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud administration, campaign operations, journey management, segmentation, automation, and platform governance. Strong understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud business units, user roles, permissions, sender profiles, send classifications, subscriber management, and campaign deployment processes. Experience managing stakeholder intake, prioritization, project planning, release coordination, documentation, and cross-functional delivery. Ability to translate business goals into technical requirements and explain platform capabilities, constraints, and operational tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. Strong leadership, analytical, organizational, communication, troubleshooting, and process improvement skills. Understanding of data privacy, consent management, email compliance, deliverability, and data quality best practices. Licenses and Certifications Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications such as Marketing Cloud Administrator, Email Specialist, or Consultant. Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Experience with Salesforce CRM, Marketing Cloud Connect, Financial Services Cloud, Customer Data Platforms, data integrations, APIs, or related MarTech infrastructure. Familiarity with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Contact Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising, CloudPages, AMPscript, SQL, and HTML/CSS for email troubleshooting. Experience working in a regulated or data-sensitive industry, preferably financial services. Experience managing vendor relationships, platform roadmaps, QBRs, support escalations, and maturity planning. Experience building scalable governance models, intake processes, QA standards, training resources, and operational playbooks. Scope of Responsibility Salesforce Marketing Cloud roadmap is clearly defined, prioritized, communicated, and aligned with business and marketing objectives. Campaigns, journeys, automations, and releases are delivered accurately, on time, and with strong QA and governance standards. Platform access, configuration, documentation, and issue resolution are managed consistently and securely. Stakeholders understand intake processes, platform capabilities, timelines, priorities, and operating expectations. Marketing automation processes become more scalable, efficient, measurable, and aligned with customer engagement goals. Platform value is demonstrated through improved campaign performance, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and stakeholder satisfaction. jd_text: STV is seeking a Senior Project Manager, for our PM/CM group in Texas. The Senior Project Manager is responsible for overseeing the planning, design, execution, and completion of construction projects, ensuring that they meet quality standards, timelines, budgets, and regulatory requirements. As a Senior Project Manager, you’ll perform project design engineering, project design staff oversight, quality control, project management, client development, proposal preparation and sales pursuits for W/WW treatment plant and conveyance projects in Texas. You’ll have a strong understanding of principles and theories of water hydraulics, pipeline mechanics and materials, operation and control, and installation means and methods. You’ll be responsible for performing all aspects of W/WW engineering. Familiarity with and/or the ability and desire to use production tools, such as modeling software and computer equipment are a plus. Principal Duties and Responsibilities: Delivering large and/or multiple projects on time, within budget and in conformance with the contract documents. Providing effective, skilled project management to help reduce the costs of delivering projects and adding value to the business by applying proven project management techniques. Assist in the execution of existing backlog and assist in the development of new work pursuits. Functions as a team lead for projects including acting as the liaison to internal departments as needed: plan, organize and direct design staff and key field positions. Execution of project designs and oversight of construction. Interface with the client to ensure expectations are identified and carried out. Responsible for project safety when part of our contract responsibility. Participates in corporate initiatives to assist in meeting the company’s goals. Assesses project requirements, while developing and recommending a sound approach or application to meet the needs of the project and client. Ensure that project deliverables satisfy project requirements and schedule. Determine, monitor, and review costs, operational budgets, schedules, and staffing requirements for projects. Manage and enhance project quality by providing ideas and suggestions to the team aimed at improving the effectiveness of their role and of the project activities in general. Establish appropriate metrics for measuring key project criteria. Facilitate the creation of communication plans, ensuring that appropriate information is exchanged among key stakeholders, and conducts status review meetings among project team members and clients. Supervise the work of others when assigned. Perform other incidental and related duties as required. Registration as a Professional Engineer in the state of Texas and a minimum of 15 years of experience. title: Sr. Product Manager (US)
jd_text: When applying for roles at Tealium, please use our official careers page or LinkedIn company profile. All other sites where Tealium careers may appear may not be legitimate. WHO WE ARE Tealium is the trusted leader in real-time Customer Data Platforms (CDP) , helping organizations unify their customer data to deliver more personalized, privacy-conscious experiences. As the demand for connected, intelligent customer engagement grows, Tealium’s leadership in CDP is translating directly into leadership in enabling enterprise AI strategies . By providing clean, consented, and actionable data, Tealium empowers its customers to accelerate the adoption of AI and machine learning, fueling smarter personalization, predictive insights, and business outcomes at scale. More than 800 leading global brands trust Tealium to power their customer data strategies and deliver real-time, personalized experiences at scale. Team Tealium has team members present in nearly 20 countries worldwide, serving customers across more than 30 countries. We win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. We are intentional about our WOWs (Ways of Work) culture, our investment in our team members, and how we care and connect. With an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including Georgian, Silver Lake Waterman, Battery, and others) and deep industry experience, Tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. Today, Tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include: A Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms 2025 TrustRadius Award Winner: Buyer’s Choice 2024 Invoca Partner Collaboration Award 2024 G2 Leader in Tag Management & Enterprise Data Governance Tealium Customer Data Hub achieved the Top Rated Award by TrustRadius (2024) Named on Destination CRM’s 2024 Top 100 Technologies List for Sales Named on the 2024 Best and Brightest in the Nation list BuiltIn’s 2024 Best Place to Work WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Tealium is seeking a Sr. Product Manager to join the Enterprise Product Team. As part of the Tealium Product team, you will build an ecosystem of products that power customer data infrastructure and insights for some of the world’s largest brands. We are looking for an autonomous, strategic thinker who proactively utilizes AI and modern tools to solve complex problems and deliver measurable, high-impact business outcomes. This role is a unique opportunity to independently steer product direction and bring to market features that transform how brands engage with and get closer to their customers. We are looking for a strategic, highly autonomous product leader who can operate independently, leverage AI and modern tools effectively, and drive measurable business impact. This role requires strong ownership, resourcefulness, data-driven decision-making, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration to solve complex problems and accelerate product outcomes in a fast-moving environment. This is a unique opportunity to shape product direction, influence long-term platform strategy, and bring innovative capabilities to market that transform how brands engage with and better understand their customers. YOUR DAY TO DAY Own the vision, roadmap, prioritization, and end-to-end execution for data collection capabilities across web, server-side, and other digital touchpoints. Define and communicate a clear product direction for helping customers collect data that is accurate, governed, consent-aware, secure, and ready for activation and analysis. Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand collection workflows, implementation challenges, regulatory requirements, and unmet needs. Translate changes in privacy regulation, consent expectations, customer needs, technology, and market dynamics into strategic product opportunities. Shape the evolution of event-based data collection, including event schemas, data quality, validation, observability, and interoperability. Break down complex problems and large, cross-functional initiatives into clear, incremental deliverables that teams can plan, build, test, and release. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, success measures, and delivery milestones that create shared clarity across teams. Partner closely with engineering and architecture to design scalable solutions that account for upstream and downstream dependencies. Use qualitative and quantitative data to validate opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, measure outcomes, and continuously refine the product strategy. Provide clear prioritization and decision-making for engineering teams while balancing customer value, technical investment, operational reliability, and business impact. Support go-to-market and adoption efforts through enablement, documentation, product demonstrations, customer conversations, and launch planning. WHAT YOU BRING TO TEALIUM 7+ years as a Product Manager building SaaS products, with proven success driving customer adoption and retention Deep knowledge of digital data collection, including client-side and server-side tracking, SDKs, APIs, data layers, event pipelines, and collection architectures. Strong understanding of event schemas, tracking plans, and data validation Experience building or managing products that support complex, customized implementations with significant upstream and downstream dependencies. Practical knowledge of consent management, privacy requirements, data governance, data security, and the impact of regulatory obligations on collection design. Experience working with customers in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, or the public sector, where privacy, security, auditability, and reliability are critical. Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical systems and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems and large initiatives into focused, measurable increments while maintaining a clear connection to the broader strategy. Strong product discovery and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes, test hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed decisions with incomplete information. Track record of influencing cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders through clear communication, sound judgment, and a strong customer perspective. Experience defining and using success metrics related to data quality, reliability, governance, customer adoption, and business outcomes. High level of ownership, autonomy, and accountability, with the ability to move work forward in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a robust benefits package that includes the following: Employees are eligible to receive an annual bonus and stock options. Employees and their families are eligible for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Employees have the option to enroll in our 401k plan and are eligible to receive contributions for company matching. Employees are eligible for flexible paid time-off and extended paid parental leave. We offer 11 paid holidays annually with an additional Healium Be-Well break for most employees. We offer 15 hours of paid work time for volunteer activities and programs. title: Implementation Consultant -- Finance
jd_text: We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow. Love Work. Love Life. title: FSP - Sr Regulatory Program Manager - client dedicated
jd_text: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description This role is designed for an experienced and forward-thinking regulatory project manager who thrives in a fast-paced, innovative environment and can seamlessly integrate strategic thinking with operational execution across all stages of product development, registration, and post-marketing. As a key member of the Global Regulatory Science team, you will partner strategically with Global Regulatory Leads to shape and execute comprehensive regulatory strategies for the U.S. and ex-U.S. markets. You will lead the development and execution of proactive global regulatory plans that articulate clear milestones, surface risks and opportunities, and support timely, informed regulatory decision-making. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role requiring strong leadership, agility, and strategic foresight. You will be accountable for driving regulatory excellence by aligning cross-functional stakeholders, managing complex timelines, and anticipating challenges to enable successful delivery of regulatory milestones that support the clients' mission to bring transformative mRNA medicines to patients worldwide. In close partnership with Global Regulatory Leads, you will also play a key role in facilitating Global Regulatory Subteam (GRST) meetings and subteam forums, ensuring effective meeting structure, clear agendas, documented decisions and actions, timely follow-up, and strong meeting hygiene consistent with project management best practices. This includes helping teams operate with clarity, accountability, and a high-performance mindset through disciplined planning, communication, and execution. Here’s What You’ll Do Partner strategically with Global Regulatory Leads to shape and execute forward-looking, globally aligned regulatory plans across all stages of development and post-marketing. Translate regulatory strategy into integrated, actionable plans with clear milestones, critical paths, risks, and opportunities to support effective planning and decision-making. Lead the execution of regulatory plans, ensuring alignment between day-to-day operations and broader strategic objectives across global programs. Identify and propose innovative regulatory pathways and planning scenarios that align with global regulatory expectations and business objectives. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to drive clarity, alignment, and accountability for regulatory deliverables, timelines, and interdependencies. Facilitate Global Regulatory Subteam (GRST) meetings and other routine and ad hoc project review forums, ensuring meetings are purpose-driven, well-structured, and focused on decision-making, risk mitigation, and regulatory execution. Apply project management best practices for meeting management and hygiene, including developing and distributing agendas in advance, defining objectives and discussion topics, maintaining action logs, documenting key decisions and next steps, tracking follow-up items to closure, and ensuring materials are stored and communicated appropriately. Partner with Global Regulatory Leads and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain effective GRST governance, meeting cadence, stakeholder alignment, and communication flow across global and regional teams. Anticipate and troubleshoot complex regulatory project and operational challenges, implementing scalable solutions that strengthen team effectiveness, process efficiency, and submission readiness. Prepare and deliver strategic dashboards, reports, and scenario plans to senior stakeholders, translating regulatory progress and risks into actionable business insights. Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table BA/BS degree in a scientific, engineering, or healthcare discipline required; advanced degree (MS, PharmD, PhD) and/or PMP certification strongly preferred. Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related life sciences industry, with at least 5 years in regulatory or regulatory program management. Proven ability to partner on regulatory strategy and lead execution across all stages of product development, including IND/BLA/MAA submissions, global registration, and post-marketing activities. Deep understanding of U.S. regulatory requirements with working knowledge of international (ex-U.S.) regulations and agency expectations. Demonstrated success managing complex regulatory deliverables across cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization, while maintaining alignment to strategic priorities. Hands-on experience with eCTD and a strong command of regulatory documentation, formatting, and submission strategy. Experience supporting global development programs across multiple modalities or therapeutic areas is highly desirable. Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to synthesize complex regulatory information and translate it into clear recommendations for senior leadership and global stakeholders. Strong judgment and agility in managing competing priorities, resource constraints, and evolving program needs with flexibility and strategic foresight. Demonstrated ability to leverage project management tools and best practices to enhance visibility, efficiency, cross-functional alignment, and meeting effectiveness across GRSTs and project teams. Demonstrated experience facilitating cross-functional team meetings, driving structured agendas, documenting decisions and actions, and maintaining strong meeting hygiene and team accountability in a matrixed environment. Committed to continuous learning and improvement, bringing an innovation mindset to regulatory execution and cross-functional collaboration. Technical Skill Requirements Expert skills required for Smartsheet and Microsoft Office Suite Expert in creating visuals using PPT generated from timeline integration tools (ie, One Pager, Office Timeline Pro, etc.) Proficient user of Veeva Regulatory Information Management (RIM)

title: Enterprise Risk Analytics & Reporting Sr Analyst
location: Remote Opportunity - VA, NC, SC, GA,  FL, AL, TX, & CO
jd_text: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions. We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here! Summary The Enterprise Risk Analytics & Reporting Sr Analyst supports enterprise risk reporting, dashboards, and data visualizations used for Executive Management and Board-level committee oversight. This role partners with Risk Management and first line stakeholders to translate data and reporting needs into clear, accurate, and actionable insights. The position helps strengthen enterprise risk reporting through data validation, reporting automation, documentation, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement of reporting solutions. Duties & Responsibilities Support the development of quarterly risk committee reporting packages, including the creation, update, and enhancement of data visualizations that communicate key risk trends and insights for Executive Management/Board-level committee oversight. Translate stakeholder reporting and data visualization requirements into new or enhanced dashboards, reports, and visualizations within Archer, Power BI, or other reporting platforms; proactively identify opportunities to improve usability, clarity, automation, and insight beyond initial stakeholder requests. Stakeholders include both second line and first line of defense partners. Perform recurring data validation, table refreshes, and reporting data quality checks to support accurate, complete, and timely reporting outputs. Coordinate with Data Engineering and other technical partners to troubleshoot data issues, support source system or table updates, and improve ETL processes, data model refreshes, and recurring data workflows to enhance reporting reliability, efficiency, and scalability. Provide stakeholder education, reporting guidance, and ongoing support to promote effective use and understanding of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations; respond to reporting questions, troubleshoot issues, and help stakeholders interpret data outputs and insights. Document reporting actions, design decisions, processes, controls, and overall strategy to support transparency, continuity, and repeatability; maintain clear documentation that enables others to understand, support, or replicate reporting and data visualization approaches. It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Qualifications Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Data Science / Analytics, or a related field Minimum Experience 3 to 5 years or greater of banking, enterprise risk management, operational risk, data analytics, reporting, or related experience Experience developing and modifying reports, dashboards, data models, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting platforms Experience working with large datasets, multiple source systems, and recurring reporting routines Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, including report management, data fields, layouts, or related configuration preferred Experience in financial services, banking, or another regulated industry preferred Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data accuracy, completeness, and reporting detail Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, concise insights Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI and Excel Working knowledge of SQL, Power Query, DAX, Snowflake, or comparable reporting and data management tools Ability to establish, follow, and document recurring reporting routines, controls, and governance standards across multiple stakeholders Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of Management Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast-paced environment Physical Demands and Work Environment Physical Demands Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time Ability to bend and reach Work Environment Office: If the position reports to a physical Company location, the setting will be a typical office environment. Hybrid positions will report to a physical Company location, as directed by the manager, and that setting will be a typical office environment. title: Enterprise Application Architect
jd_text: Position Purpose The Enterprise Application Architect is responsible for defining, aligning, and governing enterprise architecture across business applications, data, integrations, security, cloud, and emerging technologies. This role partners with business and technology leaders to translate business strategy into technology roadmaps that improve scalability, operational efficiency, cybersecurity, acquisition integration, and enterprise value. The Enterprise Application Architect provides architecture leadership across ERP, Financial, Supply Chain, HR, SaaS, integration, automation, and other enterprise platforms while establishing standards, governance practices, and future-state architecture. The role also serves as a trusted advisor and mentors architects and other technology professionals across the organization. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain the enterprise architecture vision, principles, standards, reference architectures, and governance framework. Develop and maintain business capability maps, application portfolio views, technology roadmaps, and current- and future-state architecture models. Cultivates strategic relationships with business unit leaders, serving as a trusted advisor to understand and address their evolving enterprise application needs and objectives. Lead architecture planning across enterprise applications, ERP, finance, HR, supply chain, logistics, cloud, and other technology platforms. Lead Architecture Review Board activities to ensure technology initiatives align with enterprise standards, business priorities, integration patterns, cybersecurity requirements, and approved roadmaps. Partner with business and technology leaders to understand business needs and provide strategic architecture guidance and recommendations. Partner with data and analytics teams to advance data architecture, master data management, governance, reporting, analytics, and AI readiness. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, cloud services, and digital platforms, and recommend practical business applications. Advise project teams on solution design, balancing business value, cost, risk, scalability, maintainability, speed, and enterprise standards. Communicate architecture strategies, roadmaps, standards, and recommendations to executive, business, and technical audiences. Mentor architects, engineers, analysts, and technology partners to strengthen architecture practices across the organization. Perform other duties as assigned. Reporting Relationship Reports to the Vice President, Enterprise Applications. This position does not have direct reports but provides leadership and influence across cross-functional and matrixed teams. Travel Requirements Approximately 10–20% travel may be required to business locations to collaborate with teams and stakeholders. Physical Requirements This position primarily involves standard office activities, including prolonged computer use and participation in virtual and in-person meetings. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities. Working Conditions Work is performed in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment requiring adaptability to changing business needs and technology priorities. The position may operate in a hybrid office and remote work environment. Experience Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience across enterprise applications, technology platforms, solution architecture, and related IT disciplines. Minimum of 7 years of experience in domain or solution architecture with responsibility for aligning enterprise applications with business requirements. Minimum of 3 years of enterprise architecture experience within a complex, multi-platform environment. Experience establishing architecture standards, governance practices, technology roadmaps, and cross-domain architecture direction. Experience supporting complex organizations with multiple ERP systems, distributed operations, acquisitions, integrations, or large-scale business transformation initiatives. Demonstrated experience serving as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership. Strong knowledge of enterprise applications, ERP, finance and HR systems, SaaS solutions, cloud architecture, APIs, middleware, EDI, and application modernization. Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, master data management, data governance, analytics, reporting, and data quality practices. Experience with cloud and hybrid technology environments, including Azure, AWS, multi-cloud, and on-premise solutions. This leader will play a critical role in supporting and extending our Enterprise Integration Layer (EIL) by ensuring partner integrations—whether API-based or EDI-driven—are built as reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions. The role must balance API-first strategies with established B2B/EDI transaction models required for fulfillment, logistics, and retail ecosystems. title: Customer Onboarding and Learning Systems Specialist
jd_text: Job Description:  Customer Onboarding & Learning Systems Specialist Department Customer Success Location Remote / Hybrid Reports To Director of Customer Success Type Full-Time Role Overview EZFacility is seeking a Customer Onboarding & Learning Systems Specialist to serve as both a hands-on software trainer and an architect of our next-generation onboarding experience. This is a pivotal role that bridges two critical needs: delivering high-quality, personalized training to new EZFacility clients while simultaneously helping us transition from a live-session-heavy model to a scalable, self-guided onboarding ecosystem. Today, new customer onboarding relies primarily on live Zoom training sessions totaling approximately six hours per client. Our goal over the next 12 months is to cut that in half through structured digital learning, in-app guidance, and AI-powered resources — freeing our training team to focus on higher-value, consultative support. This is a builder-and-doer role ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, creating engaging learning experiences, and experimenting with technology to improve how clients learn and adopt software. Key Responsibilities Deliver Client Training & Onboarding Serve as a software expert across all EZFacility products, guiding new clients through the critical first months of implementation. Assess each client's goals and business needs; develop customized training plans that ensure they are set up for success. Conduct live (Zoom-based) training sessions for both basic and advanced software usage, adapting your approach to each client's technical comfort level. Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to ensure onboarding is completed on schedule and aligned with client timelines. Demonstrate patience and professionalism when working with clients to resolve outstanding questions or issues. Make product recommendations based on clients' overall business objectives and act on opportunities to enhance their experience. Build a Scalable Self-Guided Onboarding Program Design and implement structured self-guided onboarding tracks tailored to different customer segments and use cases. Develop a scalable library of learning resources including short training videos, step-by-step tutorials, self-guided courses, and knowledge base articles. Create learning paths for new customer onboarding, advanced product usage, and new feature releases. Reduce reliance on live training sessions by replacing feature walkthroughs with high-quality digital content. Implement Digital Adoption & Learning Tools Own and optimize our digital adoption platform (Userpilot) to deliver in-app guidance, product tours, and contextual help experiences. Implement and manage a Learning Management System (LMS) for structured, trackable training delivery. Design guided product walkthroughs that help users learn the platform in the flow of their work. Integrate AI into Customer Education Content creation and maintenance Use AI to quickly update training materials after each product release, so customer-facing content never lags the platform. Turn recorded onboarding sessions into searchable summaries, short how-to clips, and FAQ entries. Build reusable AI prompt templates for common content types, such as release notes, help articles, and session recaps, to keep output consistent across the team. Personalized onboarding Use AI to analyze a new customer's setup, industry, and goals before kickoff, and tailor the training plan to match. Identify customers who are falling behind in onboarding, based on product usage and engagement signals, and trigger targeted learning content or outreach. Design adaptive learning paths that adjust to a customer's progress and proficiency. Self-service and support deflection Partner with Support to mine ticket data for the top recurring questions, and prioritize new training content based on what the data shows. Audit knowledge base content regularly with AI to find outdated, duplicate, or missing articles. Build contextual in-app guidance that surfaces the right help article or walkthrough at the moment a customer needs it. Collaborate Cross-Functionally Partner with Customer Success, Support, and Product teams to identify friction points in onboarding and design solutions that shorten time-to-value. Work closely with the Training Team Lead to coordinate onboarding activities and share best practices. Leverage Salesforce to track client training progress, document feedback, and streamline training initiatives. Evaluate and document client feedback for the product development team's review. Ensure all education content aligns with current product capabilities and best practices. Measure & Continuously Improve Track key metrics including onboarding completion rates, time-to-first-value, training engagement, and reduction in live training hours. Brainstorm and execute client engagement and retention initiatives such as video tutorials, webinars, and user guides. Continuously refine learning programs based on data, customer feedback, and evolving product capabilities. Qualifications Required 2+ years of experience in software training, customer onboarding, customer success, or a related field. Previous software training, customer service/support, and basic technical experience. Experience creating or delivering structured learning programs, training plans, or onboarding flows. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex product functionality into simple, approachable learning experiences. Ability to prioritize, multi-task, and work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment. Strong work ethic and the ability to meet deadlines while managing multiple client relationships. A patient, client-first mindset with a genuine commitment to resolving issues and driving client success. Preferred Experience with Digital Adoption Platforms (Userpilot, WalkMe, Pendo, Appcues, or similar). Experience implementing or managing a Learning Management System (LMS). Familiarity with AI tools for content creation, knowledge management, or training personalization. Knowledge of Salesforce for tracking training progress and client data. Video editing experience for producing training and tutorial content. Prior experience in the SaaS industry; familiarity with the sports, fitness, or recreation industry is a strong plus. Experience working with SaaS customer success or training teams. Skills & Attributes Strong systems thinking and process design — you see patterns and build solutions that scale. Instructional design sensibility — you know how to structure information so people actually learn it. Comfortable experimenting with new tools and technologies, and sharing what you learn with the team. Data-driven mindset — you use metrics to inform decisions and demonstrate impact. Collaborative and communicative — you build strong relationships with clients and teammates alike. Organized and detail-oriented — you can manage multiple client implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball. What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) Within your first year, you will: Successfully onboard a full book of new clients while delivering high-quality, personalized training. Reduce average live training hours per client from 6 hours toward 3 hours through self-guided content. Launch a structured self-guided onboarding program with supporting video, tutorial, and LMS content. Stand up and optimize our digital adoption platform to deliver in-app onboarding guidance. Introduce AI-powered knowledge and learning resources that measurably reduce support inquiries. Enable the broader training team to shift focus from feature walkthroughs to consultative, high-value onboarding. Why Join EZFacility EZFacility is a leading software platform serving sports facilities, gyms, and membership-based businesses worldwide. Our customers rely on our platform to run and grow their operations — and our team is committed to making that experience as smooth and successful as possible. As we scale, we are investing in modern onboarding and education experiences that empower customers to learn faster, adopt our platform more effectively, and realize value sooner. This role offers a unique opportunity to be both on the front lines with clients and at the center of building the future of customer education at EZFacility.                                                                                      Business Unit:  EZ Facility- USA                                                                                      Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40                                                                                      Number of Openings Available:  1                                                                                      Worker Type:  Regular More About Jonas Software: Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain. Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service. Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees. Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Work performed includes, but is not limited to, management of warehouse operations, inventory management, materials handling, equipment operation, readiness, and management of state staging areas. During special event, emergency and/or disaster operations, this position may deploy to physically austere or challenging work sites and/or work extended hours, weekends, including overnight for extended periods, sometimes with limited notice or relief, to support twenty-four (24)-hour operations at warehouse facilities. In addition, TDEM meets the Department of State Health Services (DSHS) criteria for Advanced Life Support (ALS)/First Responder Organization (FRO) status. The "pay scale" provided is a good faith estimate of the range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of hire. Actual salary will be determined based on various factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and specific geographic location. We recommend that interested candidates apply within 7 days of the posting date to ensure consideration.&#xa;&#xa; Job Description: We are looking for a strategic and highly technical LMS Architect to own and evolve our enterprise learning technology ecosystem. This person will be the primary technical authority for our Docebo platform, while leveraging their background with other LMS platforms to benchmark best practices, manage complex integrations, and ensure a scalable architecture. Key Responsibilities: Docebo Strategy & Architecture: Configure, scale, and optimize Docebo (including Extended Enterprise, Automations, and Learning Plans). Enforce governance, domain structures, and user permissions. Integrations & Ecosystem: Connect Docebo with core systems (HRIS, Salesforce, SSO/Identity Providers) using APIs and webhooks. Use experience from other LMS platforms (Cornerstone, Workday Learning, etc.) to guide ecosystem improvements. Automation & Analytics: Build automated workflows for onboarding, audience rules, and compliance tracking. Design dashboards to report on learning metrics and KPIs. Technical Troubleshooting: Ensure content compliance with modern standards (SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI) and act as the top-tier escalation point for complex integration or API issues. Roadmap & Partnering: Collaborate with L&D leaders and IT to translate business needs into technical execution and manage the vendor relationship with Docebo. Core Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in LMS architecture, enterprise administration, or learning systems engineering. Proven track record of technically configuring and scaling Docebo in an enterprise environment. Hands-on technical experience with at least one other major enterprise LMS (e.g., Workday Learning, Cornerstone, Absorb, Canvas). Proficiency with REST APIs, Webhooks, SSO (SAML 2.0, OAuth), and e-learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cMI5). Ability to build automated governance models and translate complex business requirements into system architecture. Nice-to-Haves: Official Docebo certifications. Direct experience executing LMS migrations (to or from Docebo). Experience with Extended Enterprise (multi-tenant, customer/partner-facing portals). Data/analytics skills (SQL, Power BI, Tableau). How We Partner To Protect You: TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. title: FSP Associate Manager, Safety Data and Systems - Pharmacovigilance
jd_text: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description FSP Associate Manager, Safety Data and Systems - Pharmacovigilance Design, develop and validate AI/ML and NLP components that support safety operations - including MedDRA/WHODrug auto-coding, case triage, duplicate detection and narrative summarization - with clear human-in-the-loop checkpoints Contribute to model lifecycle management for safety-relevant AI/ML: versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and documentation aligned with GxP / GAMP 5 and internal model governance Support the qualification of AI/ML solutions against evolving regulatory expectations (EMA reflection paper on AI, FDA AI/ML guidance, EU AI Act obligations for high-risk systems) in partnership with Quality, DT/BIS and GPS Signal Management Serve as the key technical resource for the configuration, maintenance, and administration of the Oracle Argus Safety system. Python, ML/NLP frameworks, model deployment/monitoring, MLOps tooling, ideally exposure to LLMs on unstructured clinical/safety text. Natural language processing for extraction of adverse events, drugs, and outcomes from unstructured text - case narratives, medical literature, call transcripts, and spontaneous reports. title: Manager, Platform Integrations & Engineering
jd_text: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Manager, Platform Integrations & Engineering The opportunity The Manager, Platform Integrations & Engineering leads a global team that designs, builds, and supports secure, scalable integrations for CRG Digital platforms and clinical research capabilities. You will set engineering standards across enterprise applications, data platforms, vendor ecosystems, and cloud technologies, while guiding the shift from bespoke development to reusable, configurable, and increasingly automated solutions. What you’ll do Lead, mentor, and grow a global team of integration and platform engineers responsible for development and production support; set clear expectations for quality, ownership, delivery, and operational excellence. Provide technical oversight across SQL, Python, Talend, MuleSoft, Oracle SOA, Tidal, Snowflake, and Databricks. Partner with Platform Architecture and solution architects to turn enterprise architecture direction into repeatable engineering patterns. Set and enforce standards for API, file-based, database, event-driven, batch, and cloud integrations, including SOPs, reusable patterns, naming and coding conventions, technical documentation, and lifecycle management. Promote configuration and reuse first, with clear criteria for when teams should configure, reuse, extend, custom-build, retain, modernize, consolidate, or replace a solution. Minimize bespoke development and modernize legacy integrations toward API-first and cloud-native patterns. Ensure integrations meet requirements for scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, performance, and operational support . Support enterprise applications, clinical and vendor platforms, APIs, cloud data platforms, external partners, and data movement into and across Snowflake, Databricks, and cloud object storage. Advance CI/CD and DevOps maturity . Establish source control, branching, pull requests, peer reviews, release management, and automated testing; build reusable unit and regression testing frameworks for standard integration patterns. Automate build validation, code quality, static analysis, vulnerability and secrets scanning, deployment gates, and release validation. Use AI-assisted development and testing where appropriate for code, documentation, test cases, troubleshooting, and repeatable work, with governance and human oversight Ensure practices comply with applicable SDLC, change-control, validation, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirements. Maintain segregation of duties, traceability, deployment approval, and production access controls. Keep integration assets documented with clear ownership, dependencies, support procedures, and lifecycle plans. Partner with Run-the-Engine and support teams on escalation paths, knowledge transfer, support documentation, and engineering ownership. Keep production integration monitored, observable, supportable, and resilient. Establish proactive logging, alerting, dependency management, and automated recovery where feasible; drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes for recurring failures. Track availability, failures, incident volume, mean time to detect and resolve, deployment quality, defect leakage, technical debt, SLA performance, development cycle time, quality, automation, productivity, integration health, capacity, and operational risk. Balance project delivery, modernization, technical debt, production support, and strategic priorities; allocate resources accordingly. Partner with Product, Architecture, Data, Quality, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, business stakeholders, and manage vendor or contractor resources to the same standards. What you will bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Comparable to 8+ years of progressive technology or integration engineering experience, including significant experience leading technical engineering teams. Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integrations in complex production environments, including production-critical services and root-cause analysis and remediation. Demonstrated technical experience with several of the following: Talend; MuleSoft / Anypoint Platform; Oracle SOA; SQL; Python; Snowflake; Databricks; and Tidal or comparable enterprise scheduling/orchestration technology. Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, file-based and database integrations, batch processing, middleware, enterprise integration patterns, and cloud data and integration architectures. Experience with Git-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review, and modern DevOps practices. Preferred experience Clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry. GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), regulated SDLC, change-control, and auditability requirements. Modernizing legacy integration estates and moving teams toward API-first, reusable, cloud-native patterns. Automated software-quality and security controls in CI/CD pipelines. Data integration for enterprise data platforms and lakehouse architectures, including Snowflake, Databricks, and cloud object storage. AI-assisted engineering in a controlled enterprise development environment. How you lead You bring technical credibility to design reviews and engineering decisions; establish disciplined standards; take ownership through root cause and lasting resolution; balance delivery with long-term architecture and sustainability; reduce manual effort, technical debt, duplication, and operational overhead; develop engineers into technical leaders; and work effectively across architecture, data, product, quality, cybersecurity, and business teams. Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours. Ability to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency. Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities. May require as-needed travel (0-20%). Location: Remote US. Lead the intake, evaluation, prioritization, approval, and sequencing of technology initiatives in alignment with organizational strategy, risk, value, and available capacity. Maintain an integrated portfolio roadmap and oversee program plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and benefits. Partner with IT and business leaders to define scope, outcomes, ownership, success measures, and delivery expectations. Coordinate resources across concurrent projects and identify capacity constraints, competing priorities, and delivery conflicts requiring leadership action. Establish practical change control, risk management, escalation, quality assurance, and project closure processes. Directly supervise IT Project Managers, including assigning and prioritizing work, setting performance expectations, providing ongoing feedback and development, conducting performance evaluations, and supporting recruitment and workforce planning. Monitor vendor commitments, contracts, deliverables, and dependencies in coordination with procurement, legal, security, and operational stakeholders. Promote effective change management, communication, adoption planning, and transition to operational support. Define and track PMO metrics, identify trends, and recommend corrective actions or process improvements. Seven years of progressive experience in project, program, or portfolio management, including responsibility for complex cross-functional technology initiatives. title: Program Manager, Learning & Development
jd_text: Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. YOU The Program Manager, Learning & Development is responsible for managing, measuring and continuously improving enterprise employee and leadership development programs that strengthen organizational capability, support talent priorities, and drive measurable business impact. This role supports the Training COE and partners closely with training leaders (L&OD, Sales and Operations), facilitators, vendors, and other key training stakeholders to translate development strategies into scalable learning experiences, effective program operations, and meaningful outcomes for employees, leaders, and the business. Success in this position requires strong program and vendor management, stakeholder engagement, learning design knowledge, operational discipline, and a data-driven approach to evaluating effectiveness and improving participant experience and outcomes. The role plays a critical part in ensuring development programs are well-governed, executed, aligned to enterprise priorities, and continually optimized to build targeted skills, strengthen leadership capability, and improve organizational performance. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (% of Time) Program Deployment, Delivery Management and Governance (50%) Lead end-to-end deployment and execution of development programs, including planning, scheduling, communication, participant management, facilitator coordination, logistics, and stakeholder support. Manage annual program calendars, cohort schedules, enrollment processes, and learning technology requirements to ensure consistent and scalable program delivery. Support program budget development, tracking and reporting processes. Develop and maintain standard work, operating procedures, and governance processes that improve efficiency, quality, and participant experience across all programs. Develop and execute communications (pre, post and during training programs) that build awareness engagement and adoption of learning programs Serve as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, vendors, facilitators, and participants throughout the program lifecycle. Ensure programs align to organizational learning and compliance standards, processes, service-level agreements and documentation practices. Program Design & Development (30%) Design and manage employee and leadership development programs aligned to enterprise talent, succession, and workforce capability priorities. Partner with business leaders, HR partners, and subject matter experts to conduct needs assessments and translate business requirements into measurable learning objectives, program structures, and participant journeys. Create and maintain program frameworks, materials, communications, evaluation tools, and supporting resources that promote learner engagement and achievement of desired outcomes. Design programs to support manager engagement, post-training reinforcement, learning transfer and sustainability. Ensure programs incorporate modern learning design and approaches, organizational values, and best practices in leadership and employee development. Evaluate and leverage learning management systems and other learning technologies to support program administration, training delivery, learner engagement, tracking and reporting. Measurement, Analytics & Continuous Improvement (20%) Establish and manage program measurement strategies that evaluate participant experience, learning effectiveness, behavioral adoption, and business impact. Analyze program data, assessment results, participation trends, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and increased effectiveness and impact. Develop executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and reports that communicate program performance, business impact and recommendations for future enhancements. Continuously refine program design, delivery practices, and measurement methodologies to drive greater organizational impact and learner engagement and outcomes. DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE If you can do everything listed above, you’ve got what it takes. Perhaps some of the following would be helpful too: Education Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Learning or Organizational Development, Business or related field required. Experience 8+ years of progressive experience in learning & development, organizational development, training or talent development. 3+ years of demonstrated project/program management experience managing complex, cross-functional training or learning programs from planning through execution and evaluation. Experience coordinating training logistics and managing the end-to-end learner experience. Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning technologies; familiarity with virtual learning and digital learning platforms. Experience partnering with business leaders, subject-matter experts, facilitators and cross-functional teams. Experience with training evaluation, metrics, reporting, scorecards and data analytics to assess program effectiveness and business impact. Experience managing RFPs, vendors and external partners. Skills & Capabilities Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, budgets and stakeholders. Operational rigor with a focus on standardization, scalability, and continuous improvement. Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities/problems, exercise sound judgment and develop practical solutions. Data-driven mindset with experience in training measurement and analytics. Experienced and effective communicator and storyteller within a business environment. Ability to “meet an organization where they are at” and design solutions that move the organizational maturity forward in a way and pace that the organization accepts and culturally embraces. TRAVEL REQUIRED This job requires less than 10% domestic travel. WORK STATUS & LOCATION This full-time, exempt position is ideally located in Pleasanton, CA or Plano, TX. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally push or lift up to 25 lbs. title: Diabetes Education Program Manager
jd_text: Job Title Diabetes Education Program Manager Agency Texas A&M University Health Science Center Department TAMHSC McAllen Campus Proposed Minimum Salary Commensurate Job Location McAllen, Texas Job Type Staff Job Description Our Commitment Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service. Who we are As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery. What we want The Program Manager is responsible for managing and facilitating all program activities of the Diabetes Education Program (DEP). The Program Manager will work closely with leadership to ensure efficient and effective health education and outreach in the 4-county service area of the Rio Grande Valley (Starr, Hidalgo, Cameron and Willacy Counties). This position will be primarily located at the main Texas A&M Health – Rio Grande Valley office in McAllen, TX. What you need to know Schedule: This position may occasionally require work beyond normal office hours and/or work on weekends. Travel: This position may require up to 30 % or more of travel throughout the 4-county service area (Starr, Hidalgo, Cameron and Willacy Counties) and occasional (as needed/required) overnight travel to Corpus Christi and/or College Station, TX for training, meetings, etc. Responsibilities: Program Management and Administrative Duties Manage day-to-day Diabetes Education Program (DEP) activities throughout the 4-county service area of the Rio Grande Valley (Starr, Hidalgo, Cameron and Willacy Counties). Operates and manages the clinical side of DEP, which includes overseeing inventory and requisition of necessary medical program supplies, medications, equipment, etc. Maintains a close working relationship with the Director and keeps well informed of all DEP activities, changes, issues, data collection/analysis, and/or concerns. Attend meetings with Director to discuss planning, program review, program development, grant acquisition, budget evaluation, and program effectiveness. Assists in developing short/long term goals, objectives and strategic planning. Assists in the development of special reports and/or information requested by the Director. Supervises and provides directions to program staff and other clinicians to include student assistants/interns. Maintains a regular and consistent meeting schedule with the entire DEP staff to ensure quality and outstanding care and service to our participants and community partners/stakeholders. Develops and maintains working relationships with community partners/stakeholders and DEP participants which includes marketing/outreach activities and attending seminars, conferences, training, etc. Evaluates the content, teaching methods, and performance of all program educators and assistants. Oversees and manages all program data collection, analysis and evaluation to support program efficiency and effectiveness. Travels to various locations within the service area of the Rio Grande Valley (Starr, Hidalgo, Cameron and Willacy Counties) for program activities in a personal or University vehicle. Occasional travel to Corpus Christi and/or College Station, TX for training, meetings, etc. Manages the social media/marketing activity for DEP. Stays well versed in new trends of evidence-based practice in diabetes and other chronic illnesses. Works closely with other staff to ensure the diabetes education program meets the American Diabetes Association (ADA) standards and program recognition is maintained within the field and at the community and state levels. Works closely with Coastal Bend Regional DEP leadership, county public health officials, and other staff as appropriate for best practice and curriculum adjustments, etc. Develops educational program material, learning resources, and evaluation tools for specific educational clinical interventions. Program Functions The Program Manager will be the lead clinician at Texas A&M Health – Rio Grande Valley and will oversee and manage all programmatic functions to include daily operations, evaluation, development, and implementation of health education programs throughout a 4-county service area (Starr, Hidalgo, Cameron and Willacy Counties). Schedules and conducts health and nutrition education classes, including diabetes self-management care and education. Prepares and delivers presentations to our participants and community partners/stakeholders. Maintains and monitors participant records, assesses health care needs, and provides participant health education. Completes health screenings for program participants, to include, but not limited to: HbA1c, cholesterol, blood pressure, hip and waist circumference, and body mass index (BMI). Conducts initial and follow-up assessments for program participants. Provides nutrition counseling, cooking demonstrations and individual educational consultations with our participants and/ or community partners/stakeholders. Assists as needed during program events i.e., classes, presentations, community health fairs, Family Night, etc. Assists participants with the completion of program documents to include pre and post-tests and other evaluation tools. Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree Five (5) years of professional work experience that includes supervision of staff in a health-related field. Required Licenses and Certifications State License and American Dietetic Association Registration and License (RD/LDN). Preferred Qualifications Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES) certification or ability to obtain certification within one year of employment. Master’s degree in a health-related field. Fluent in English and Spanish. Valid driver’s license. More than five (5) years of professional work experience that includes supervision of staff in a health-related field.
