title: Manager, IT Support Services
jd_text: Position Purpose: The Manager, IT Support Services is responsible for leading and overseeing the Service Desk Team, ensuring the delivery of exemplary customer service and technical support to employees across our Corporate Campus and Branches. This role requires strategic leadership to manage the Team effectively, ensuring compliance with established processes and procedures while fostering an environment of continuous development through mentorship and training. The Manager collaborates with senior IT leadership to align technology needs with business objectives and supports executive-level requests, contributing to critical IT projects and providing insightful KPI and metrics reports to the Director, IT Operations. Key Responsibilities: Provide strategic leadership and mentorship to the IT Service Desk Team, fostering a culture of self-sufficiency and teamwork to enhance overall operational efficiency. Ensure strict adherence to established Service Desk processes and Change Management policies, maintaining high standards of compliance and operational integrity. Offer advanced technical direction and innovative problem-solving strategies to the Team, enhancing their ability to tackle complex troubleshooting scenarios with efficiency. Oversee and optimize the IT Service Management (ITSM) ticket assignment and escalation process, ensuring thorough documentation, accurate routing, and prompt resolution to meet service level agreements. Develop and implement ongoing training and development programs to nurture talent and advance the skill sets of Team members, supporting their professional growth. Efficiently manage workforce planning, ensuring comprehensive coverage across all support channels, including overseeing scheduling, approving overtime, and facilitating leave management. Collaborate effectively with IT Leadership to strategically forecast and procure necessary hardware and software resources, aligning with organizational needs and future demands. Deliver insightful KPI and metrics reports to the Sr. Director, IT Operations, providing data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement and service excellence. Direct Manager Direct Reports: The Manager, IT Support Services reports directly to the Sr. Manager or Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations. This role is responsible for leading and providing strategic direction to the Service Desk Team, ensuring that top-tier customer service and support are delivered to Corporate Campus and Branch employees across various divisions. The Manager does not hold any direct reports; instead, the position involves collaborative partnerships with the Team and Sr. IT Leadership to enhance IT support services. Duties include monitoring service compliance, overseeing ITSM processes, and participating in strategic IT projects. The Manager also plays a key role in metrics reporting and resource forecasting, working closely with the broader IT Leadership Team. Travel Requirements: The Manager, IT Support Services is required to travel to various Branch Locations for participation in Acquisition and Greenfield-related projects, as determined by the needs of the IT Operations Team, with frequency aligned to project timelines and strategic objectives as directed by Senior IT Leadership. Physical Requirements: The Manager, IT Support Services position primarily involves work performed in an office environment, requiring the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods. Duties necessitate proficiency in using office equipment, including computers, phones, and other related technology, essential for overseeing and supporting the Service Desk Team. The role involves regular communication and collaboration with team members and other departments, requiring the ability to convey information clearly both verbally and in writing. Occasional travel to branch locations may be required as part of project-related responsibilities. Working Conditions: The Manager, IT Support Services will operate within a hybrid work environment, combining both remote and in-office settings, designed to optimize performance and team collaboration while offering flexibility. This position commands a fast-paced and deadline-driven atmosphere, necessitating agility in prioritizing tasks and adherence to high standards of service delivery. As part of the IT Operations Team, the Manager is expected to seamlessly integrate into the dynamic work environment at the Corporate Campus and Branch locations, coordinating effectively with Sr. IT Leadership and other team members. The role demands a strong commitment to maintaining a consistent line of communication and oversight, ensuring that all objectives are met efficiently while fostering a productive and supportive working atmosphere for the Service Desk Team. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT support or a related field, with at least 3 years in a supervisory or management role. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team in a high-demand, service-oriented IT environment. Proficient in modern IT Service Management (ITSM) tools and practices. Strong knowledge of Change Management processes and service desk operational procedures. Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to handle escalated technical issues. Experience in scheduling, resource allocation, and managing team coverage to meet organizational needs. Proven ability to develop and mentor staff, providing guidance and fostering professional growth. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of effective collaboration with multiple stakeholders. Experience with or knowledge of IT project management, particularly in acquisitions and expansions. Ability to travel as needed, particularly in support of acquisition and greenfield projects. Proficiency in using KPI metrics to drive team performance and report outcomes to senior leadership. Ability to manage executive-level support requests with professionalism and discretion. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Technical Expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in managing and supporting enterprise-level IT environments, with a focus on IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks such as ITIL. Advanced certifications in technologies related to support services are highly desirable. Leadership and Development Skills: Proven track record of developing high-performing teams through effective coaching, mentoring, and talent development strategies. Experience in driving a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. Project Management Experience: Experience in managing large-scale IT support projects, including acquisitions and expansions. Ability to coordinate cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders to deliver projects on time and within budget. Communication and Interpersonal Abilities: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to interface effectively with executive leadership, vendors, and all levels of the organization. Demonstrated ability to translate technical issues into business impacts and solutions. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to assess situations, gather data, identify problems, and recommend viable solutions. Experience in implementing data-driven decision-making processes is preferred. Strategic Planning and Execution: Experience in developing and implementing strategic IT support initiatives that align with business objectives. Ability to anticipate future IT support needs and proactively design solutions. Technology Acumen: In-depth knowledge of the latest developments and trends in IT support technologies, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, and remote support solutions. Experience in deploying and managing these technologies in a corporate setting is a plus. Customer-Centric Approach: Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and enhancing user experience through the effective management of IT support services. Ability to build strong client relationships and drive continuous improvement in service delivery. Compliance and Risk Management: Knowledge of regulatory requirements impacting IT support services and experience in ensuring compliance with relevant standards. Ability to assess and mitigate risks related to IT operations. Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited institution. Preferred Education: A Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required; a Master's degree or professional certifications in IT Service Management or related disciplines is strongly preferred. Minimum Years Of Work Experience: A minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in IT support services, with at least three (3) years in a leadership capacity, are required for this role. Certifications: ITIL Foundation Certification, essential for managing IT Service Management processes. CompTIA A+ or equivalent, preferred to enhance technical acumen and support skills. Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, preferred to ensure proficiency in relevant technologies. HDI Support Center Manager (HDI-SCM), preferred to reinforce leadership and support center operation capabilities. Mentor team members, fostering an environment of continuous learning and growth to build high-performance support teams. Strategic Planning and Execution: Demonstrate the ability to strategically plan and execute service desk operations, ensuring alignment with the organization's objectives and the needs of multiple divisions across Corporate Campus and Branch locations. Technical Proficiency: Possess deep technical expertise for effective problem solving and to provide technical direction to the team, enhancing their troubleshooting capabilities and optimizing overall service delivery. Process Management and Compliance: Ensure strict compliance with established Service Desk processes, procedures, and Change Management policies. Monitor adherence and enforce protocols to maintain consistent and high-quality service standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support initiatives like hardware and software forecasting, Executive-Level Support, and acquisition projects. Approve overtime, vacation, and personal time off requests to sustain a balanced workload and meet service demands. Performance Metrics and Reporting: Oversee the tracking and reporting of KPIs and service desk metrics to the Director, providing insights into performance trends, areas for improvement, and strategic decision-making. CHARLES HEALTH SYSTEM JOB DESCRIPTION TITLE: IT Portfolio and Demand Management Specialist REPORTS TO POSITION: IT Manager Customer Experience DEPARTMENT: Information Technology DATE LAST REVIEWED: September 2026 OUR VISION: Creating America’s healthiest community, together OUR MISSION: In the spirit of love and compassion, better health, better care, better value OUR VALUES: Accountability, Caring and Teamwork DEPARTMENT SUMMARY: The Information Technology (IT) department helps improve the work of our caregivers by providing efficient systems, comprehensive training, and stellar customer service. We do this by taking pride in the integrity of our workflows, data security, and training delivery. We partner with our customers to best leverage various technologies to achieve the best patient outcomes possible by implementing new hardware and software solutions, upgrading existing environments, protecting the data we store, and integrating different solutions to achieve a seamless experience. POSITION OVERVIEW : The IT Portfolio and Demand Management Specialist facilitates the IT demand management function by overseeing the intake, evaluation, and prioritization of technology-related requests across the organization. This role partners closely with business and IT leaders to ensure proposed initiatives align with strategic priorities, operational objectives, compliance requirements, and available resource capacity. The position establishes intake standards, facilitates decision-ready business cases, maintains clear visibility into the demand pipeline, and supports portfolio decisions that optimize the delivery of IT services, enhancements, and projects. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES: Facilitate the IT demand management process by capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing incoming requests from business units to ensure alignment with organizational strategy, operational needs, and resource capacity. Establish and enforce intake standards to ensure demands are accurately classified as service requests, enhancements, optimization efforts, or projects, enabling efficient routing and decision-making. Develop, maintain, and communicate portfolio dashboards, executive summaries, scorecards, and pipeline reports that provide transparent visibility into demand intake, prioritization, status, portfolio health, resource capacity, and decision points. Partner with business and IT stakeholders to organize, validate, and mature business cases; define scope, objectives, benefits, assumptions, dependencies, funding considerations, and the appropriate path for each request, including conversion to project work, operational support, optimization, or other intake channels. Ensure business cases are complete and decision-ready by coordinating required inputs such as approvals, level-of-effort estimates, discovery findings, architectural review, and stakeholder alignment. Facilitate cross-functional assessment of regulatory, security, technical, and operational risks associated with new demands to support informed prioritization and governance decisions. Monitor and administer the demand intake lifecycle, ensuring requests progress through defined stages such as submission, triage, discovery, estimation, approval, deferral, rejection, or conversion to project or operational work. Coordinate the assignment and tracking of non-project work to the appropriate operational pathways, ensuring accurate categorization, accountability, and follow-through for intake items that do not become formal projects. Ensure proposed initiatives are reviewed for compliance with legal, regulatory, privacy, and organizational requirements prior to approval and execution. Govern the demand pipeline and portfolio backlog to ensure initiatives are scored, ranked, prioritized, and sequenced in alignment with enterprise strategy, operational priorities, technical dependencies, financial stewardship, risk, and available organizational capacity. Define, implement, and continuously refine prioritization criteria, scoring methods, and review practices that support consistent portfolio and demand management decisions. Facilitate recurring demand and portfolio review forums by preparing agendas, decision materials, scoring summaries, capacity views, tradeoff options, and follow-up actions for leadership review and direction. Maintain portfolio data quality within demand and portfolio management tools, ensuring request records, stage gates, approvals, benefit statements, priority scores, resource estimates, and disposition decisions remain accurate and current. title: Sr. Manager, Information Security
jd_text: Responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of a team of Information Security Analysts responsible for frontline monitoring and response to security alerts and incidents. Will work closely with IT leadership, security leadership, enterprise architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure the organization maintains effective, risk-based security practices that support business objectives. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Security Operations Leadership Lead and manage a team of Information Security Analysts responsible for monitoring, triaging, and responding to security alerts and incidents. Serve as an escalation point and actively participate in incident response activities to ensure rapid containment and resolution of security events. Establish and reinforce a culture of urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement within the security operations team. Drive improvements in detection, response processes, playbooks, tooling, and operational effectiveness. Challenge the status quo and identify opportunities to strengthen the organization’s defensive capabilities. Program Leadership & Execution Partner with leaders across Development, IT, Product, Operations, HR, Accounting, and Marketing to implement and operationalize the enterprise Information Security strategy. Own and manage key components of the Information Security program, ensuring consistent execution across business units. Translate strategic security objectives into actionable roadmaps, initiatives, and measurable outcomes. Support cross-functional teams in addressing security risks and strengthening security practices across the organization. Governance, Risk & Compliance Stay informed on emerging vulnerabilities and threats and partner with IT teams to ensure timely remediation. Operationalize the Information Security policy, standards, and guidelines framework. Support the implementation and ongoing operation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned to recognized frameworks (e.g., NIST, SOC, SOX, COBIT). Manage internal and external audit activities including security questionnaires, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and audit readiness. Metrics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement Develop and maintain security metrics and reporting that measure the effectiveness and maturity of the Information Security program. Provide regular reporting and insights to senior leadership and governance committees, escalating risks and gaps when appropriate. Identify and lead initiatives to improve security controls, processes, and operational maturity. Awareness, Resilience & Risk Management Oversee and mature the Security Awareness and Training program to strengthen the organization’s security culture. Leadership & Culture Mentor and develop Information Security Analysts, helping them grow technically and professionally. Promote a proactive security culture by encouraging collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Communicate security risks and priorities effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Represent and reinforce the organization’s values and culture in all interactions. title: Assistant Operations Manager - Final Mile
jd_text: NXTPoint Logistics provides a complete range of end-to-end supply chain solutions spanning from distribution, warehousing and fulfillment to managed logistics, transportation and final mile delivery. It leverages broad 3PL capabilities, market-leading technology and deep vertical industry expertise to help both large and small clients reach greater levels of efficiency, service and profitability. With over 30 owned facilities, more than 3.5 million square feet of warehouse space and an extensive partner network, NXTPoint Logistics offers the broad capabilities and reach of a large 3PL company while maintaining its commitment to being the most flexible and responsive provider in the industry. Learn more at nxtpointlogistics.com. SUMMARY The Assistant Operations Manager supports the daily execution of delivery and installation operations while assisting with workforce management, contractor performance, customer satisfaction, and operational compliance. This role partners with the site management to monitor operational performance, support employees and independent contractors, address service issues, and help ensure customer requirements are met. Depending on location structure, the position may provide direct supervision and development of employees while supporting overall operational performance and service execution. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Support the day-to-day execution of delivery and installation operations to ensure customer expectations and service commitments are achieved. Assist in supervising and developing employees and independent contractor teams, providing coaching, guidance, and performance feedback as needed. Support recruiting, onboarding, training, and retention efforts for employees and independent contractors. Help ensure all delivery teams are properly qualified, documented, and prepared for daily route execution, including required licensing, insurance, certifications, equipment, and customer-specific requirements. Assist with monitoring operational KPIs, including route completion, service failures, customer satisfaction, productivity, dropped routes, and reschedule performance. Assist in addressing employee, contractor, and operational performance concerns and support corrective actions when necessary. Support daily staffing, routing and driver team capacity planning to meet customer service requirements. Coordinate resolution of delivery, installation, customer service, and when needed contractor-related issues. Build and maintain positive relationships with customers, employees, independent contractors, and internal teams. Support customer communications and service recovery efforts related to operational issues and escalations. Assist with contractor qualification, onboarding, and compliance processes. Partner with operations leadership to address any identified service concerns and improvement plans. Conduct operational meetings, training sessions, and performance discussions with employees and contractors as needed. Education and Experience Four (4) year college degree in Business, Supply Chain Logistics, or related field preferred. Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in the transportation, logistics, or related industry required. Experience working in a dispatch or operations support or management role required. Valid state driver’s license required. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and other MS Office products. Ability to work in a team environment and demonstrate flexibility and patience. Excellent organization, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to multi-task and manage time effectively. Ability to sufficiently read, speak, and write English in order to understand and give directions, and to complete paperwork accurately. Ability to operate a variety of standard office equipment as dictated by the duties of the job and perform data entry and typing functions. Physical Demands and Working Conditions Work is primarily performed in a climate-controlled environment. Occasionally requires work performed in a non-climate-controlled warehouse or outside environment. Requires sitting, walking, and standing. Occasionally requires bending and stooping. Occasionally requires standing and walking for long periods of time. Ability to lift and stack items weighing up to 30 pounds over head, and lift and stack items weighing up to 65 pounds to chest height and carry them a distance of fifty feet. Occasional ability to climb ladders, stairs, and ramps and perform moderately heavy labor in various weather conditions and temperatures. Work performed requires the use of hands to control or feel objects and will utilize repetitive movements when entering data. Requires the use of clear speech communicated to others and understanding the speech of another person. Requires the ability to see details of objects within close range. *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. title: Project Operations Analyst
jd_text: At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with. Who We Are We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses. Overview: The Staff Project Operations Representative serves as a strategic lead in the end-to-end management of complex project lifecycles, from contract approval and technical sign-offs to final Permission to Operate (PTO). In this high-impact role, you will manage a portfolio of sophisticated projects while acting as a key partner for channel onboarding and support. Beyond daily execution, this role is a critical driver of scalability, influencing the development of future policies and operational processes as we expand into new products, partners, and markets. Summary: The Staff Project Operations Representative will be responsible for the overall process of approving Contracts, Plan Sets, Installation Proofs, Electrical Sign Off, and Permission to Operate notifications. They will also be responsible for managing projects to ensure milestone approvals are processed in a timely manner. This all-encompassing role will be dedicated to a single, highly complex, project type and will be responsible for multiple projects at a time. The Staff Project Operations Representative will be influential in the contribution to process development as we expand into new markets, products and partnerships. Reporting to Project Operations Supervisor on the Multifamily Team. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Management of numerous projects throughout each individual project’s life cycle by working with Development Managers, Project Managers, Designers, and other internal teams to progress projects to completion. Support expansions into new markets, products, and partners including: onboarding new partners & markets, tailoring training materials, managing access and account set up, and training new partners on process and policy. Liaison with partners to problem solve and answer any questions, escalating issues where appropriate with recommendations, while also helping to make any process updates to ensure streamlining and the best experience for all parties involved Develop and leverage technical knowledge of solar system design and installation management and apply that to the review of plan sets, contracts, and other project documents to approve project milestones for Sunrun and install partners. Develop and decide on suitable strategies and objectives when faced with roadblocks, multiple projects, requests, inquiries, and deadlines. Review sets of documents to ensure compliance with terms and alignment with Sunrun milestone requirements. Review and compare data points against contract packages for accuracy and completeness based on policy & SOX requirements while then processing and approving milestones and communicating these approvals internally and with Partners. Advanced data analysis to improve existing automation including workflows, processes, cycle times, and deployment methodology. Prioritize and process requests and queries from other teams including Installation, Project Finance, Accounts Payable, etc. Maintain team’s wide variety of project management tools and create data tapes with accurate information for recurring daily, weekly, monthly requests and SOX compliance. Use Salesforce.com and other database reports to perform recurring audits to ensure data accuracy and address any inconsistencies. Meet deadlines, handles and prioritizes simultaneous requests, and manage laterally and upwards Requirements 4+ years of work experience. Solar and data systems experience a plus. Experience with Salesforce.com, Google Suite, and project management tools preferred. Flexible and able to prioritize multiple tasks and deadlines and work independently to resolve problems to deliver results and complete a variety of simultaneous tasks with a high level of organization. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills along with effective communication skills with peers and other levels and departments Recruiter: Jacquie Hoffman (jacquie.hoffman@sunrun.com) Please note that the compensation information is made in good faith for this position only . It assumes that the successful candidate will be located in markets within the United States that warrant the compensation. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more. Starting salary/wage for this opportunity: $58,128.72 to $77,504.97 Compensation decisions will not be based on a candidate's salary history. You can l earn more here . title: Sr Data Analyst I, RWE
jd_text: Sr Data Analyst I, RWE Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. Job Responsibilities JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS • Contribute to the design of RWE studies, including protocol development, ability to lead statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and other key study documents with minimal/modest supervision; must be able to lead SAP development without supervision for “straightforward” studies, e.g., treatment patterns, purely descriptive studies. • Apply comprehensive knowledge of real-world data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, omics data, wearable data, PROs) to inform study design, feasibility assessments, and methodological decisions. • Strong fluency in at least one of SAS or R is mandatory. • Perform advanced statistical analyses using SAS, R, Python, SQL, and/or other appropriate tools, ensuring data quality, reproducibility, traceability, and methodological rigor. • Develop operational definitions, code lists, and analytical specifications aligned with study objectives and industry standards. • Prepare high-quality tables, figures, and listings (TFLs) and contribute to study reports, manuscripts, and client deliverables with clear interpretation of findings and articulation of limitations. • Experience in providing client-facing support, including presenting planning and project updates, explaining methodologies, addressing technical questions, and contributing to strategic discussions. • Demonstrate a consulting-oriented approach by proactively identifying risks, proposing solutions, and adapting to evolving client needs. • Manage programming timelines and analytical workstreams across multiple concurrent projects; communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively to internal and external stakeholders. • Occasional support of proposal development, desk research, and exploratory analyses as needed. QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS • Master’s degree or higher in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience (to demonstrate experience, explicit supporting evidence is required). • 5 years (minimum of 3 years) of project-based experience conducting RWE research using secondary healthcare data sources (e.g., claims, EMR/EHR, registries, hospital databases, lab/genomic data, wearable data, PROs). • 5 years (minimum of 2 years in a consulting setting) of hands-on statistical programming experience (e.g., SAS, R, Python, SQL) in a research or consulting setting. • Strong understanding of RWE methodologies, observational study designs, bias and confounding control methods, and data governance considerations. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with client-facing experience and preparing deliver-ready results and presenting to stakeholders. • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight timelines. • Demonstrated consulting mindset with the ability to translate analytical results into strategic insights and practical recommendations. Get to know Syneos Health Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients. No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health. http://www.syneoshealth.com Additional Information Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. title: Application Support Specialist III
jd_text: Position Summary The Application Support Specialist III is a senior technical support professional responsible for providing advanced technical expertise in the support, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of Dark Matter applications and supporting technologies. W orking with a high degree of independence, this role leads the investigation and resolution of complex client and production issues, coordinates critical incident response, performs root cause analysis, and drives sustainable corrective and preventive actions. Provides technical guidance concerning application support, business processes, integrations, and emerging AI-enabled solutions. Responsibilities are based on depth and scope of support expertise, client impact, and complexity of issue resolution. Job Responsibilities Provide advanced Tier 3 application support to clients and internal users, resolving complex functional, technical, configuration, integration, and data-related issues within established service-level and severity guidelines. Serve as a technical escalation point for critical incidents and high-severity production issues; assess impact and urgency, coordinate responders, maintain clear stakeholder communications, and support restoration of service. Reproduce reported issues in appropriate test environments; isolate contributing factors; document findings; and distinguish application defects from configuration, data, infrastructure, integration, or user-process issues. Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant incidents and partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and other teams to implement corrective and preventive actions. Use SQL to investigate incidents, validate data, reconcile results, and support troubleshooting while following data-access, privacy, and security requirements. Review application logs, code paths, and system interactions; apply working knowledge of .NET and C# to debug issues and collaborate effectively with development teams. Monitor application health, availability, performance, and operational trends to identify service risks and recommend preventive improvements. S upports application deployments, releases, upgrades, maintenance activities, and change management processes. Analyze APIs, integrations, distributed services, and business process flows to identify dependencies, failure points, and downstream impacts. Create and maintain accurate knowledge articles, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known-error records, and operational procedures. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activities, improve observability, reduce recurring incidents, and strengthen the client and user experience. Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to less experienced specialists without direct people-management responsibility. Handle other related responsibilities consistent with the role. AI Support & Innovation Responsibilities Supports AI-enabled applications, copilots, intelligent automation solutions, and machine learning-powered products utilized by Dark Matter and its clients. Monitors AI solution performance, usage trends, and operational effectiveness. Investigates and resolves issues related to AI-generated outputs, workflow failures, prompts, integrations, and data quality concerns. Assists with AI feature testing, validation, and user acceptance activities to ensure quality, accuracy, and business alignment. Collaborates with Product and Engineering teams to evaluate AI enhancements and recommend improvements. Document AI support procedures, governance requirements, best practices, and troubleshooting methodologies. S upport responsible AI practices by following established requirements for privacy, data security, regulatory compliance, human oversight, and appropriate use. Use approved AI tools in day-to-day work to improve research, analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and process efficiency while validating outputs before use. Identifies opportunities where AI capabilities can improve client experience, employee productivity, and support operations. Maintains awareness of emerging AI technologies and industry best practices relevant to application support and client success. Competencies Client focus - Builds trust through responsive, accurate, and transparent support. Technical problem solving - Uses evidence, pattern recognition, and disciplined analysis to isolate causes. Business acumen - C onnects technical details to client workflows, risk, and downstream impact. Incident leadership - C reates clarity, coordinates action, and communicates effectively during high-pressure events. Ownership and execution - Takes issues through resolution, verification, documentation, and follow-up. Communication - Tailors concise technical and business messages to the audience. Collaboration and mentoring - Shares knowledge, coaches peers, and works effectively across teams. Adaptability and learning agility - Quickly learns unfamiliar tools, interfaces, processes, and emerging technologies. Quality and judgment - Challenges assumptions, validates evidence, protects data, and makes practical decisions. Continuous improvement - Identifies recurring patterns and converts lessons learned into durable improvements. Required Qualifications At least 7 years of progressive experience supporting enterprise software applications, including complex production support and client-facing issue resolution. Demonstrated experience supporting Empower Loan Origination System (LOS) in a production environment, including issue resolution, workflow troubleshooting, system configuration, user support, and coordination with business and technical stakeholders. Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across SaaS, web-based, multi-tier, or distributed application environments. Hands-on experience with SQL Server or a comparable relational database, including the ability to write queries for investigation and data validation. Working knowledge of object-oriented programming and .NET/C#, including the ability to review code and collaborate with software engineers on defect resolution. Experience supporting APIs, integrations, application monitoring, incident management, release support, and change-control processes. Ability to assess impact, urgency, and risk; prioritize competing work; and escalate in accordance with service-level and severity standards. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings for client, business, and leadership audiences. Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and lead technical investigations with limited guidance. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint. Preferred Qualifications E xperience in mortgage banking, financial services, banking technology, or fintech. Experience supporting Dark Matter products or a comparable mortgage technology ecosystem. Experience with cloud-based services, modern application architectures, observability platforms, and IT service management practices or frameworks such as ITIL. Experience supporting AI-enabled applications, copilots, intelligent automation, chatbots, or machine-learning solutions. Experience mentoring support professionals and improving knowledge-management or operational-support processes. Role Expectations Operates as a senior individual contributor and recognized technical resource; this role may lead investigations and mentor peers but does not inherently include direct people-management responsibility. Maintains confidentiality and complies with applicable security, privacy, regulatory, and records-management requirements. Participates in scheduled production-support coverage, release activities, or incident response as required by business needs and company policy. Participates in a scheduled on-call rotation to support production incidents, critical system issues, releases, and after-hours operational support activities as required. title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Omnichannel/Paid Media)
jd_text: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry. STAY AWESOME: Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com A DAY IN THE LIFE: The Senior Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for leading integrated digital marketing strategies that build awareness, engage priority audiences, and drive measurable business results. This role connects paid media, email, web, audience activation, campaign measurement, and optimization into a cohesive customer experience across the full funnel. The position translates brand, product, and business objectives into audience-led strategies, scalable campaign plans, measurement frameworks, and clear optimization recommendations. The Senior Digital Marketing Manager partners closely with Analytics, Brand, Product Marketing, Brand Operations, Brand Experience, Sales, IT, Legal, Regulatory, Privacy, international teams, and external agencies to deliver effective digital programs in a fast-paced, regulated environment. A Senior Digital Marketing Manager's at Tandem are also responsible for: Leads integrated digital marketing strategy and execution across paid media, email, web, audience activation, and emerging digital channels in support of brand, product, launch, and business objectives. Translates audience insights, customer journeys, market priorities, and business goals into channel strategies, campaign briefs, media plans, testing roadmaps, and measurable performance goals. Owns digital campaign performance, including budget pacing, channel effectiveness, funnel progression, conversion, cost efficiency, and return on marketing investment. Builds measurement frameworks and dashboards with Analytics and Marketing Operations; synthesizes data into decision-ready insights, risks, tradeoffs, and optimization actions for senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Leads experimentation across audiences, creative, messaging, offers, landing pages, media mix, and campaign sequencing to improve performance and customer experience. Partners with Brand, Product Marketing, Creative, Web, CRM, Sales, Marketing Operations, IT, and other cross-functional teams to deliver coordinated omnichannel programs and consistent customer experiences. Supports international and multi-market launches by establishing scalable digital strategies, launch playbooks, channel requirements, timelines, measurement standards, and localization guidance for language, culture, media behavior, regulatory requirements, approved claims, and market-specific business needs. Manages external agencies, technology partners, direct reports, and/or project teams by setting clear scope, priorities, roles, deliverables, budgets, performance expectations, feedback, and accountability. Strengthens campaign enablement in partnership with Marketing Operations and technology teams, including audience activation, lead management, tracking, tagging, consent, and data quality. Ensures digital initiatives comply with company policies and applicable legal, regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and promotional review requirements, including Privacy/HIPAA where relevant. Monitors digital marketing trends, platform changes, competitive activity, and emerging technologies; recommends practical opportunities to improve reach, relevance, efficiency, and differentiation. WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK: Remote: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Demonstrated expertise in integrated digital strategy, paid media, lifecycle/email marketing, web experiences, audience activation, and campaign optimization. Deep expertise in integrated digital strategy, paid media, lifecycle/email marketing, web experiences, audience activation, campaign optimization, and full-funnel measurement. Strong knowledge of major advertising, analytics, tag management, and marketing automation platforms, with the ability to apply data to improve performance and customer experience. Ability to connect business objectives, audience insights, channel strategy, creative, media, measurement, and optimization into a cohesive plan. Strong analytical, project management, and program leadership skills, including the ability to manage multiple campaigns, launches, markets, agencies, budgets, and deadlines simultaneously. Proven ability to lead through influence, manage agencies or team members, collaborate across global and regional teams, and communicate strategies, insights, and recommendations clearly. EXTRA AWESOME: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, Digital Media, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and applicable experience. Advanced degree or relevant digital marketing certifications preferred. 12-15 years of progressive digital marketing experience, including ownership of integrated, full-funnel campaigns across multiple digital channels. Experience leading complex campaigns, product launches, media budgets, agencies, vendors, and/or cross-functional teams. Experience supporting international or multi-market launches, including localization, regional coordination, and adaptation to market-specific requirements. Experience in medical devices, healthcare, or another regulated industry is preferred. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: The starting base pay range for this position is $ 141,800 - $177,300 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package. Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here ! YOU SHOULD KNOW: Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information. Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders. SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE: At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers . BE YOU, WITH US! We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us. Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone. REFERRALS: We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share! APPLICATION DEADLINE: The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications. Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow. #LI-KT1 #LI-Remote

We make sure we hire the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it’s time to imagine what it’s like being a Senior Operations Manager. Responsibilities: As a Senior Operations Manager of the AV Rider Assistance & Dispatch unit, you will manage day-to-day operations business, including performance, billing, P&L and resource forecasting for a growing fleet. Manage a high-performing team of Operations Managers and Team Leads, ensuring they are coached in both leadership and AV technical literacy. Design and scale response frameworks that accommodate unique AV challenges, including software-defined edge cases, hardware failures, and environmental obstacles. Drive KPI excellence across specialized AV metrics, balancing technical Resolution Rates and Safety Benchmarks with business metrics like CSAT and AHT. You will meet with Senior Management and clients as needed to continue business growth. Ensure compliance with evolving regulatory and legal standards specific to autonomous transportation. We need someone who has the proven ability to scale operations, drive performance management, and foster employee retention. Own the hiring and talent development pipeline, identifying candidates with the "top-notch" analytical skills required to thrive in a fast-paced technology environment. Foster an organizational culture that prioritizes safety, innovation, and rapid adaptation to technological change. Requirements: Two-plus years of experience as a Senior Operations Manager or seven-plus years of experience as an Operations Manager in high‑stakes or safety‑critical environments (e.g., transportation, automotive, aviation). Autonomous Vehicle Experience is must . BA/BS degree preferred. Experience managing supervisors, as well as coaching and developing Teammates. 20% travel required to support market launches, conduct field audits, and meet with regional stakeholders. title: Sr. Manager, Commercial Learning & Development – Operations
jd_text: Opportunity awaits those up to the challenge of developing transformative therapies across a broad range of debilitating diseases. Summary: The Sr. Manager, Commercial Learning & Development – Operations will lead the infrastructure, processes, and standards that enable the Commercial Learning & Development function to operate with efficiency, compliance, and scalability. This individual will serve as the operational backbone of the team, ensuring consistent execution across the Biogen franchise portfolio. The role requires exceptional organizational and systems expertise, strong project management skills, and the ability to partner cross-functionally to establish standards and governance that ensure Commercial Learning & Development delivers with excellence on behalf of the business. Roles and Responsibilities: Own the operations and governance model for Commercial Learning & Development, establishing standards, processes, and documentation that drive consistency and accountability. Create, optimize, and maintain standard training class schedules, including Integrity Selling class schedules, coordinating facilitators, participants, and logistics across therapeutic areas. Support the structure and stand-up of the new learning management system (LMS), and manage and continuously improve systems and tools (e.g., LMS, Veeva, certification tracking) to ensure compliance, efficiency, and accuracy. Standardize training surveys and lead reporting and analytics (survey aggregation, metrics, dashboards) to monitor performance and inform business decisions. Develop and oversee the Commercial Learning & Development calendars, scheduling, and project trackers, ensuring alignment and transparency across stakeholders and cross-functional partners. Support Training Managers with scheduling, calendar invitations, and territory and field organization activities to enable efficient, well-coordinated training delivery. Provide hands-on support for training initiatives as needed, stepping in on delivery and execution to maintain continuity and quality. Serve as the liaison between administrative support and cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication, timely handoffs, and coordinated execution. Standardize communications and templates to improve stakeholder engagement and efficiency. jd_text: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Join us as a Manager, Clinical Operations - And take on a leadership role in overseeing clinic operations, driving process improvements, managing a team of healthcare professionals, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and enhancing patient care and service quality. title: Front of House Operations Manager
jd_text: Topgolf | Front of House Operations Manager Job Description ABOUT TOPGOLF Topgolf is a sports entertainment company that has changed how millions of people experience golf and where you can build a serious career. Our venues are high-energy, high-volume environments where performance matters and results are visible. Every day, we bring together golf, food and beverages, events, and entertainment into one experience that keeps guests coming back. WHAT WE’RE SEEKING Do you see operations as the foundation that makes every great guest experience possible? Are you the person who spots the process that is slowing the team down and fixing it before it becomes a pattern? We are looking for a Front of House Operations Manager who combines operational precision with genuine hospitality instinct. Someone who can manage systems, workflows, and staffing while never losing sight of the fact that it all exists to serve the guest. Efficiency and experience are not in conflict. In your hands, they reinforce each other. If you believe great operations are what make great hospitality repeatable, this is the role for you. THE ROLE The Front of House Operations Manager leads both the Guest Services and Food & Beverage teams in delivering best-in-class service and hospitality across the entire front of house. This is a merged leadership role responsible for two of the most guest-facing parts of the Topgolf experience. This role is accountable for hiring, scheduling, coaching, and developing team members across both functions, and for managing all operations related to game and bay experiences, food and beverage service, guest safety, retail, and leagues. Proven track record owning large, complex projects end‑to‑end: architecture, execution, rollout, and long‑term support and maintenance. Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner with product, design, UX design and ML teams in a fast‑moving environment. Preferred Skills & Experience Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines (i.e., GitHub Actions) Hands‑on experience integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into production applications, including prompt/response management, cost controls, and safety considerations. Experience with AI‑adjacent infrastructure: vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, or custom retrieval pipelines. Experience having direct interaction and communications with customers. title: Security Operations Lead (GSOC)
jd_text: SWBC is seeking a talented individual who will provide hands-on operational leadership for the Global Security Operations Center in a converged cyber and physical security environment. Why you'll love this role: This role places you at the center of SWBC's security operations mission, where you will help lead real-time cyber and physical security monitoring, coordinate high-priority incidents, guide analysts through complex investigations, and collaborate with internal teams, managed security providers, and technology partners. You will have the opportunity to influence operational excellence, improve detection and response capabilities, mentor security professionals, and help mature a modern Global Security Operations Center supporting a highly regulated enterprise environment. title: Credit Risk Manager
jd_text: Credit Risk Manager Houston TX | Credit At Talen Energy This is a senior-level energy credit risk role combining credit analysis, trading exposure management, collateral and liquidity management, contract negotiation, quantitative risk modeling, and process improvement. How You’ll Power the Future At Talen Energy, your work directly supports safe, reliable power generation. In this role, you’ll move beyond day‑to‑day contributions to drive meaningful change by: Own counterparty credit risk management across power and gas trading portfolios, including daily exposure monitoring and preparation of clear, decision ready risk reporting for senior management and key stakeholders. Perform ongoing creditworthiness assessments through proactive monitoring of counterparty financial condition, market developments, and industry trends; recommend appropriate credit limits and collateral requirements. Manage collateral for bilateral and cleared transactions, coordinating with various internal stakeholders. Develop and maintain credit risk models and metrics, including Potential Future Exposure (PFE), to support portfolio level and counterparty specific risk analysis and decision making. Lead initiatives to improve automation and operational efficiency within the credit function through cross functional collaboration. Maintain and govern credit terms, limits, and related data within the company’s ETRM system, ensuring data integrity and auditability. Independently negotiate credit terms in enabling agreements and credit support documentation across multiple business lines (ISDA, NAESB, PPAs, etc.); experience with lien-based structures preferred. Conduct stress testing of hedge portfolios to evaluate incremental liquidity requirements under adverse market conditions. Analyze valuation changes across trading products and clearly communicate key drivers, risk implications, and portfolio impacts to commercial stakeholders. Evaluate and explain changes in Initial Margin (IM), Variation Margin (VM), and Net Option Value (NOV) resulting from market movements, volatility, and portfolio composition. What You Have Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree or professional certification such as CFA or FRM preferred. Deep understanding of ISO/RTO market operations and associated credit requirements, including collateral, settlement, and default frameworks. Proven ability to analyze financial statements, assess counterparty creditworthiness, and set risk appropriate credit limits across a diverse portfolio. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to confidently engage, influence, and constructively challenge traders, marketers, and senior leadership on risk decisions. Highly organized and self-directed, with a demonstrated ability to prioritize competing deadlines, exercise sound judgment, and operate effectively in a fast-paced trading environment. Able to meet requirements for nuclear plant background clearance, where applicable. Preferred Qualifications 8+ years of progressive credit risk management experience within the power and gas trading sector, including advanced knowledge on derivatives and complex hedging structures. Hands on experience managing exchange traded and cleared exposures, with a strong grasp of margin drivers (initial margin, variation margin, net option value) and their impact on liquidity and capital usage. Advanced proficiency in Excel, VBA, and SQL preferred. Why Talen Energy? Power the Future Talen Energy is one of the largest competitive energy and power generation companies in North America. We operate power plants that use diverse fuel sources in the most attractive wholesale power markets and sell energy to wholesale and retail customers in selected competitive markets. Our passion for excellence grows value through safe and efficient operations. We have an inclusive, diverse, respectful, and collaborative workplace, and a strong commitment to innovation, teamwork, and integrity. We generate energy for a brighter tomorrow. title: Senior Credit Analyst
jd_text: Talen Energy is currently seeking a Senior Credit Analyst. In this role you will be responsible for monitoring and managing the liquidity and counterparty risk of the company. title: Lead Data Analyst
jd_text: Job Title Lead Data Analyst Agency Texas A&M Agrilife Research Department Dallas Proposed Minimum Salary Commensurate Job Location Dallas, Texas Job Type Staff Job Description About Texas A&M AgriLife Texas A&M AgriLife is comprised of the following Texas A&M University System members: Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service Texas A&M AgriLife Research College of Agriculture and Life Sciences at Texas A&M University Texas A&M Forest Service Texas A&M Veterinary Medical Diagnostic Laboratory As the nation’s largest most comprehensive agriculture program, Texas A&M AgriLife brings together a college and four state agencies focused on agriculture and life sciences within The Texas A&M University System. With over 5,000 employees and a presence in every county across the state, Texas A&M AgriLife is uniquely positioned to improve lives, environments and the Texas economy through education, research, extension and service. Click here to learn more about joining AgriLife! Position Information Job Summary: The Lead Data Analyst, under general direction, serves as a technical lead on complex data projects. Provides technical oversight for the application of and compliance with technical standards. Completes reports and summaries for management and users including project status reports, problem reports, and progress summaries. Responsibilities: Provide leadership and strategic direction for data analysis activities across a portfolio of public health and nutrition research projects, ensuring alignment with organizational and research goals. Supervise, mentor, and support data analysts and junior statisticians; delegate tasks, facilitate professional development, and provide technical guidance and quality assurance. Oversee the design, implementation, and continual optimization of data analysis workflows, ensuring best practices are established and maintained across projects. Review and document data structures to support both current and future research objectives at the program and institutional level. Lead the development and application of advanced statistical models and methodologies, including but not limited to: multilevel modeling, mixed models for clustered randomized trials, longitudinal data analysis, and other advanced statistical techniques for complex datasets. Oversee the design and execution of statistical analysis plans, including power and sample size calculations, for diverse study designs (e.g., randomized controlled trials, community-randomized trials, longitudinal cohorts) and ensure these meet funding requirements and research objectives. Supervise the establishment, maintenance, and improvement of data collection systems; direct data collection and quality assurance activities, including programming forms, monitoring data integrity, and developing data cleaning procedures. Coordinate acquisition, cleaning, merging, and management of data from multiple secondary sources (local, state, and national databases) and ensure robust data governance and compliance with relevant privacy and security policies. Develop quality control assessments to identify and resolve data issues, implement process improvements, and train team members on best practices in data management and cleaning. Oversee and ensure the quality of documentation for data workflows, cleaning, and analysis procedures, and ensure reproducibility and transparency across all stages of the analytic process. Prepare or review reports, manuscripts, presentations, and visualizations of analytic findings for internal and external use; ensure clarity, accuracy, and suitability for various audiences. Collaborate with principal investigators, multidisciplinary research teams, and external partners (including funding agencies and data stewards) to interpret findings, advise on data strategy, and translate results into actionable insights. Lead the development of statistical and analytic sections of grant proposals, supporting funding initiatives and program growth. Participate in strategic planning for the data analytics function and represent the data analysis team in broader organizational initiatives. Performs other duties as assigned. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, nutrition, statistics, clinical research) or equivalent combination of education and experience. At least 6 years of professional experience in data collection and analysis, including direct experience with statistical modeling and management of research datasets. Proficiency in statistical programming languages (e.g., R, SPSS, Stata, SAS), data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), and database applications. Demonstrated experience leading the preparation of research manuscripts and securing grant funding. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to effectively communicate with faculty and staff. Detail oriented and ability to organize tasks and prioritize work with minimal supervision. Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in nutrition epidemiology or related field (e.g., public health, nutrition, statistics, or relevant education and experience meeting job expectations). At least one year of related experience. Experience working with and accessing local, state and national data sets (e.g., Texas health data, NHANES, WHI, Framingham Heart Study, etc.). Experience developing valid, reliable composite scoring and screening instruments (e.g., Life’s Simple 7; dietary screeners; etc.). Knowledge and understanding of the mission and role of the Land Grant University System, including community-campus partnership and the Extension system. What You Need to Know Salary: Compensation is commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications. Flexible Work Arrangements: Flexible work schedules and remote work options may be available for this position, depending on the nature of the role and employee eligibility, in accordance with AgriLife Alternate Work Location Procedures. title: Operations Manager, Space Institute
jd_text: Job Title Operations Manager, Space Institute Agency Texas A&M Engineering Department Space Institute Proposed Minimum Salary Commensurate Job Location Houston, Texas Job Type Staff Job Description Why work for Texas A&M Engineering? Engineering has been part of Texas A&M University since its opening in 1876 as the Agricultural and Mechanical College of Texas. Today, the College of Engineering is the largest college on the College Station campus with more than 25,000 engineering students enrolled in 15 departments. Its mission is to serve Texas, the nation and the global community by providing engineering graduates who are well-founded in engineering fundamentals, instilled with the highest standards of professional and ethical behavior, and prepared to meet the complex technical challenges of society. As the research arm of Engineering, the Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station (TEES) is a state agency within the Texas A&M University System with a mission to improve lives through basic and applied engineering research, workforce development and technology transition. Our collaborations with industry, academia and government provide cutting-edge solutions to global technical challenges. We are deeply committed to recruiting and retaining a talented workforce that embraces our core values of Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Service, by offering competitive salaries, an array of benefits, an extensive support network, and above all, an enriching and highly collaborative working community that is deeply passionate about our vision for higher education, research, and public service. Job Description Purpose: The Operations Manager, under direction, leads and oversees facility operations, maintenance, and infrastructure support for the Texas A&M University Space Institute in Houston. This position is responsible for ensuring that facilities are safe, secure, functional, and capable of supporting a dynamic, multi-tenant environment. The Operations Manager contributes to the overall effectiveness of the Institute by maintaining high operational standards, supporting tenant needs, and ensuring facility and equipment readiness to support high-quality facility operations in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Responsibilities: Oversees preventative, corrective, and planned maintenance, including mechanical, electrical, HVAC, custodial, and grounds operations. Oversees day-to-day facility operations to ensure the building is safe, secure, functional, and maintained in accordance with university policies and applicable regulations. Serves as primary point of contact for facility-related issues, and service requests ensuring timely response and resolution. Coordinates and manages vendor services, contractors, and maintenance providers to ensure quality performance and compliance. Oversees building access control, key management, badging, tenant onboarding, and facility usage processes; conducts regular reviews of access permissions to ensure appropriate and secure access. Leads facility safety, emergency preparedness, and business continuity efforts, including safety training, fire drills, evacuation procedures, emergency response planning, corrective actions, and participation in on-call response activities. Assigns and coordinates facility proctors, safety monitors, and other personnel as required to support daily operations, events, and specialized activities. Oversees the operation, maintenance, enhancement, and reconfiguration of specialty environments, including the Moon and Mars analog scapes, utilizing and coordinating the operation of heavy equipment and specialized machinery. Coordinates with business operations staff on supply ordering, equipment service requests, purchase documentation, and related administrative processes. Establishes processes and maintains records of maintenance activities, work orders, inspections, and performance metrics. Supports space utilization planning and assists with coordination of facility modifications or improvements such as new equipment installation. Provides communication and guidance to staff and tenants regarding facility operations and procedures. Monitors facility performance and identifies opportunities for operational improvements. Coordinates with internal university departments and external partners to support facility operations. Performs other duties as assigned. What We Need: Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Five (5) years of related experience in facility operations, maintenance, or project coordination. Other Requirements: This position is security sensitive and requires United States Citizenship only. What Is Helpful: Experience working in higher education, research, or complex multi-tenant facilities. Experience coordinating vendors, service contracts, and maintenance activities. Knowledge of building systems, maintenance practices, and safety standards. Work Location: Houston, TX. About The Texas A&M Space Institute: The Texas A&M University Space Institute will advance commercial, government, military, and academic research and development partnerships in support of national and international space endeavors. With a $200 million investment from the State of Texas, a 400,000 square foot facility is under construction at NASA-Johnson Space Center's Exploration Park. This unique facility, featuring the world's largest indoor climate-controlled landscapes to emulate surface operations on the moon and Mars, is expected to open in the fall of 2026 and will support space system research, testing, training, and workforce development initiatives. Texas A&M Engineering provides an outstanding benefits package including but not limited to: Competitive medical insurance benefits through Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas and Prescription coverage by Express Scripts. Options for Vision , Dental , Life , and Long-Term Disability insurance. A defined benefit retirement plan with the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS) with 8.25% employer contribution. Additional Voluntary Retirement Programs: Tax Deferred Account 403(b) and a Deferred Compensation Program 457(b). Flexible spending account options for medical and childcare expenses Generous paid time off with holidays , vacation and sick leave . Robust free training access through LinkedIn Learning plus professional development opportunities. Tuition assistance and Educational release time to further your academic pursuits. Access to Engineer Your Wellness programs that provide opportunities for employees to engage in health and fitness. Wellness release time offered to employees to promote work/life balance. Helpful Applicant Information Required Materials for Application: Resume/CV Three work references with their contact information; at least one reference should be from a supervisor/former supervisor. Letter of interest Applications received by Texas A&M Engineering must have all required job application data entered. Failure to provide all job application data could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. Recognize and reward exceptional performance based on individual and team contributions to the growth and success of Texas A&M Engineering. Offer total rewards through flexible benefits, professional development, and work-life balance. Maintain an equitable and transparent process for compensation decisions. Support, reinforce, and align compensation decisions with budgetary and financial strategies to ensure growth and sustainability.
